verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no in-product AI that analyzes the user's data to produce insights or suggestions. Bento's in-product AI 'builds' things from plain-text descriptions, which is generation rather than insight. The MCP server lets an external AI assistant query the account, which happens outside the product. Both are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
